cves.description: Microsoft Exchange Server validation key remote code execution vulnerability. A remote code execution vulnerability exists in Microsoft Exchange software when the software fails to properly create unique keys at install time.
Microsoft Exchange Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability, also known as ProxyLogon, allowing an attacker to send arbitrary HTTP requests and authenticate as the Exchange server.

VMware Workspace ONE Access, Access Connector, Identity Manager, and Identity Manager Connector command injection vulnerability that could allow an attacker with network access to the administrative configurator to execute commands.
